name: dyoe-trust-mcp
description: MCP server for DYOE's 22 pay-per-call x402 tools: scam and trust checks, payment pre-flight, wallet screening, agent approvals, contacts and data. USDC on Base.
long_description: Each tool is one paid endpoint at agents.dyoeway.org, settled per call in USDC on Base via x402. Without a wallet the server runs in free PREVIEW mode and returns the 402 payment requirements. With a dedicated, low-balance wallet key it pays automatically, capped per call (default $0.10).

tools.name: dyoe_verify
tools.description: DYOE Trust Check ($0.01). Check whether a website, business, or wallet is a scam before an agent trusts or pays it — fraud, phishing and rug-risk screening. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), trust_score, domain age, red_flags. Input: ?target=domain

tools.name: dyoe_transaction
tools.description: DYOE Payment Pre-Flight ($0.10). Vet an entire payment before an agent sends money: is the counterparty site legit, is the payee wallet sanctioned or disposable, is the amount within policy. Returns proceed/caution/stop, reasons, and a signed attestation — one go/no-go instead of three calls. Input: ?domain=merchant.com&wallet=0x...&amount=500

tools.name: dyoe_wallet
tools.description: DYOE Wallet Screening ($0.05). Screen a crypto wallet address before an agent sends funds to it: OFAC sanctions check, on-chain footprint (empty or disposable address), human-vouch overlay. Returns verdict (safe/caution/avoid), sanctioned flag, on-chain activity, red_flags. Input: ?address=0x...

tools.name: dyoe_approve
tools.description: DYOE Policy Authorization ($0.02). Approve or deny an agent action instantly against a human-set policy — no waiting. Returns a signed decision receipt; anything over the policy line escalates to a human. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required)

tools.name: dyoe_review
tools.description: DYOE Human Sign-Off ($15.00). Get a named human to review an agent action against a checklist and sign off on it. Poll /api/task?id=<id> for the signed receipt. Priced on the amount at stake. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required)

tools.name: dyoe_contacts
tools.description: DYOE Contact Extraction ($0.01). Extract public business emails, phone numbers, and social profiles from a website. Batch-safe contact enrichment for autonomous agents. Input: website URL. Returns structured JSON.

tools.name: dyoe_intel
tools.description: DYOE Company Research ($0.10). Research a company or website in one call: what they do, legitimacy verdict, domain age, how to reach them, social presence, scam red flags — background checks for agents. Sources disclosed, not a black box: RDAP registry domain age, HTTPS reachability, on-page contact signals, DYOE human-vouch registry. Input: ?target=domain

tools.name: dyoe_merchant
tools.description: DYOE Store Safety Check ($0.05). Is this online store safe to buy from? Scam/fraud check + trust verdict (safe/caution/avoid) + store signals (checkout, returns, payment methods) — counterparty trust for shopping & commerce agents before they pay. Input: ?url=

tools.name: dyoe_audit
tools.description: DYOE Website Audit ($0.05). Score any website 0-100 for legitimacy, trust, SEO and contactability — due diligence on a company in one call. Returns a verdict plus prioritized fixes. Input: ?url=domain

tools.name: dyoe_reputation
tools.description: DYOE Reputation History ($0.05). Look up the track record of any domain or wallet: how many times it has been assessed, verdict history, times flagged, first and last seen, a reputation score and a signed credential — a credit score for counterparties. Computed only from DYOE's own logged prior assessments; thin history is labeled as such. Input: ?target=

tools.name: dyoe_credential_org
tools.description: DYOE Org Credential ($0.10). Issue a signed, independently verifiable credential that a business domain passed a trust check — returns verdict, trust_score and domain_age. Input: ?domain=

tools.name: dyoe_token
tools.description: DYOE Token Intelligence ($0.05). Look up a token's price and market data plus a scam and rug-risk read on the project behind the coin — market data and counterparty trust in one call. Input: ?symbol=

tools.name: dyoe_extract
tools.description: DYOE Text Extraction ($0.01). Extract clean main text content from any web page (no nav/ads) — for research & summarizing agents. Input: ?url=

tools.name: dyoe_metadata
tools.description: DYOE Page Metadata ($0.01). Extract title, description, OpenGraph image, favicon & canonical from any URL — link previews & summaries. Input: ?url=

tools.name: dyoe_crypto
tools.description: DYOE Crypto Price ($0.01). Live crypto price + 24h change, market cap & volume for any coin — for trading agents. Input: ?symbol=btc

tools.name: dyoe_market
tools.description: DYOE Crypto Market ($0.01). Global crypto market overview — total market cap, 24h change, BTC/ETH dominance. Input: (none)

tools.name: dyoe_trending
tools.description: DYOE Trending Coins ($0.01). The coins trending right now — for trading & research agents. Input: (none)

tools.name: dyoe_movers
tools.description: DYOE Top Movers ($0.01). Top gainers & losers (24h) across the top 100 coins — for trading agents. Input: (none)

tools.name: dyoe_fx
tools.description: DYOE Currency Conversion ($0.01). Currency conversion + live exchange rate (ECB data). Input: ?from=USD&to=EUR&amount=100

tools.name: dyoe_weather
tools.description: DYOE Weather ($0.01). Current conditions + 3-day forecast for any city — for travel & planning agents. Input: ?city=Atlanta

tools.name: dyoe_wiki
tools.description: DYOE Topic Summary ($0.01). Factual summary of any topic from Wikipedia — for research agents. Input: ?topic=Bitcoin

tools.name: dyoe_destination
tools.description: DYOE Destination Intel ($0.05). Get what a trip-planning agent needs before it books, in one call: weather and 3-day forecast, local currency with live FX from USD, and a scam check on the booking site before it pays. Input: ?city=Athens&date=2026-11-20&currency=EUR&booking=hotel-site.com&budget=1500

wallet_private_key.title: Base wallet private key (optional)
wallet_private_key.description: A DEDICATED, low-balance Base wallet holding USDC. Leave empty for free preview mode (returns the 402 quote). Never use your main wallet.

max_payment_usd.title: Max payment per call (USD)
max_payment_usd.description: Calls priced above this are refused locally. /review costs $15.
